t: This is Bell Yard, a street in the City of Westminster. The person connected with it is Sir Anthony Keck, who died here in 1695. He was an English lawyer and politician. He served as a Member of Parliament from 1691 until his death in 1695, and before that was a Commissioner of the Great Seal, from 1689 to 1690. The material on the street itself is thin, so I'll say no more.
